title: FRÖSVI folding chair
description: FRÖSVI folding chair, black/Knisa dark gray A smart choice to make the most of your smaller living space. The padded seat and back make it nice and comfy, and when it is time to clean up or make space for other activities simply fold and stow. Sturdy and durable chair frame made of solid hardwood.
